question: Admit this POC (profile poc) with the four criteria, non-goals, the 1-day budget and the stop conditions as written? Approving accepts all of them as written and enters implementation; each outward action still asks first.

artifacts.summary: Probe before the inbox-r1 Pilot: a Netlify function verifies a Standard-Webhooks-signed CloudEvents fixture, dedupes with a strong Blobs onlyIfNew write, dispatches the scratch workflow with an Actions-write-only credential and posts the run link to Slack; three sends of one webhook-id must yield one run, a tampered send none, with latency measured.
